FAQ

## Questions about plans and cost

What drives the number, what is included, and how deployment options affect it.

Still have a question? [Ask us directly](https://koodisi.com/contact).

### Why are there no prices on this page?

Because the number depends on things a table cannot capture — whether you run in our cloud or your own, how many environments you need, and what support commitment sits behind it. Rather than publish a figure that turns out to be wrong for your setup, we quote against what you are actually running. Tell us the shape of it and we will be direct about the cost.

### How is Koodisi billed?

Not per task and not per operation. A workflow that takes ten steps does not cost ten times a workflow that takes one, and adding a step to something that already runs does not change what you pay. That is the part teams most often get burned by elsewhere, so it is worth saying plainly.

### Can I see Koodisi before we talk pricing?

Yes. Book a demo and bring a workflow you actually run, ideally one that already breaks. We will build it with you on the platform, so you can see how it handles failures and change before any conversation about cost.

### Is there more than one plan?

No. Koodisi is sold as one enterprise plan with unlimited workflows, executions, and users. What changes the quote is how you deploy it, how many environments you need, and the support commitment behind it, not which features you can switch on.

### What happens as our usage grows?

Your bill does not move with every new step or run, because Koodisi is not billed per task or per operation. If you add environments, move from cloud to on-premise, or need a tighter SLA, we revisit the quote together, and your workflows, environments, and history carry over unchanged.

### Can we run Koodisi on our own infrastructure?

Yes. Koodisi runs in our cloud, on-premise, or as a hybrid where the control plane is managed and execution stays inside your network. Which one you need is usually decided by data residency or by a system that cannot be reached from outside, so it is worth raising early.

### We need to run a security review before we can buy.

Send the questionnaire and we will fill it in with you. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits are complete and approved for certification, with certificates in the issuing pipeline, and the security page documents the controls a review usually asks about. Public sector buyers can transact through GSA and Texas DIR.

### What happens when I contact sales?

We ask what you are connecting and what has to hold in production, then quote against that. If Koodisi is a poor fit for what you are doing, we would rather say so early than sell you a plan you leave in a year. Write to info@koodisi.com or book a demo and bring a workflow that already breaks.

## Tell us what you are running.

Bring the systems you need to connect and the constraints you have to meet. We will tell you how Koodisi covers it and what it costs.
